modalities.evidence: case information, vital signs, laboratory results and medication data

output.population: 27350 admissions to intensive care units at the University Hospital Salzburg, collected between 2013 and 2021 across four ICUs.
output.summary: Deidentified intensive care database from four ICUs at an Austrian tertiary hospital, covering admissions with case information, vital signs, laboratory results, medication and preceding surgeries, at hourly and per-minute resolution.
